integrity: The theorem is an integral homotopy equivalence; finite tests corroborate a separate symbolic all-order argument. Unindexed priority equivalence remains possible.
scientific_limitations: Classification is for Latin squares of order >=5 and their ordinary graph clique complexes. No equivariant statement, no wider orthogonal-array classification, and no independently audited proof are claimed.
title: Integral two-sphere wedges for clique complexes of arbitrary Latin-square graphs
